blst.license_and_shim_digest_note: git normalises LF to CRLF on the Windows checkout, so the working-tree digests of the licence and shim differ per platform while the git-object source-tree digest does not. These are checkout digests, never platform-independent content digests.

offline_reproof.note: Both bundles were re-verified offline against the embedded trusted root with the custom predicate type and signer workflow enforced. The linux subject also carries two historical SLSA attestations signed by the qualification workflow at refs/pull/357/merge; the predicate-type filter excludes them and they are not admission evidence.
